sense.text:
“Where there is no vision, the people perish”. “but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.” Vision is tethered to keeping God's laws. Without the laws you have no vision. Because we keep them, we understand going into the community, teaching, cleaning up, meeting our people, having social groups and family days so people from the world can see what we're about. We aren't waiting for society or the powers that be to make a way. God's word applied with his laws gives us vision, moves us, and motivates great things.

You young men and young women are the next generation to take this truth to another level. There must be a line of succession to keep this movement moving. This is a young man's and young woman's movement. Older people with scriptural experience give guidance and mold you, but you are its bloodline. Stay godly. This world has nothing to offer you. We've learned to mobilize the youth; the churches and Nation of Islam aren't on the front lines reaching you in the hood like before. The young boy saying he's tired of church shows the disconnect. A brother spitting in his hand and putting it in another man's face—that's a hustle, a game. We're going out looking for you.

Radicalization is starting to believe or support extreme views, and in some cases participating in terrorist groups or acts, motivated by ideologies, religious or political beliefs, or prejudices. The part we're taking is supporting extreme views. We do not condone terrorist acts. We're not picking up guns. If you know of a crime being committed, alert the authorities. This is changing our minds. The music gives young people a voice and a sense of purpose. Become occupied in the Lord's work, not just coming because your mother or father makes you. When your heart turns and you want to come, the walk becomes deliberate instead of a burden.

David was young when he went to battle; the old people were scared. He wouldn't let the uncircumcised Philistine talk to us like that. That is the young mind ready to defend against evil. Look at those young men in the 1970s clip questioning the older man: has God told you to let this white man rule you? They would rather die standing than on their knees begging for jobs. What happened to that zeal? There's a plot to keep young men passive and effeminate, women overbearing, and us in dysfunction. You are going to take this truth further if you believe and follow instruction.

“Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world.” Don't have an affinity for or be enamored with its devices. What it offers young men is sin, sexual immorality, becoming whoremongers, homosexuals, sexual deviants. What it offers young women is becoming baby mamas and devaluing yourselves and your bodies. Young people love it because everybody is doing it. Our views are extreme—the polar opposite of the world. It takes fortitude to be an Israelite at school, under peer pressure, and say I don't care what everybody's doing; I'm not joining that. “If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.”

“I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning.” The him is God, the Most High, not your son. The father has known the Most High from when he was young, and now instructs his son not to love the world. That's a leader's instruction to a young man. I was young once; I can relate to where you are. Your greatest gift is listening. You haven't lived enough to understand certain things, even when they make sense to you. Listening saves heartache. If you're already angry about correction, you won't last in this truth; you're going to fall away.

“I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong”. You can stand on corners teaching for 14 hours; some of us old men can't. “and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.” You must be physically, mentally, spiritually strong. Abide means to house in you. These young ones are going to take over, understand this Bible, and teach it. This is edification, not playing church.

“And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.” That's why we do it. If the word abides in you and you don't love the world, you're looking for eternal life. “concerning them that seduce you.” What makes the word leave you? Sin isn't a wrong answer, but seduction is the word. You wouldn't just agree to eat pork, become a whore, or smoke crack. Someone has to seduce you away.

If you're a different person in public school than here or at home, you're seduced. Be the extreme opposite of the world. It doesn't matter what those kids say or do. That little petite guy with a diamond in his forehead—they're pulling you away from the truth. Radicalize your mind instead.

“But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you”. Let it abide. “and ye need not that any man teach you”. That doesn't mean nobody teaches you scripture. “but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things”. You don't need the teaching that seduces you away from the Bible. Get away when they start it. They're dimming your light; we're turning it up. Be offensive to this world by your behavior. Again, no guns, no violence. IUIC is a nonviolent movement. We will protect ourselves; that's different. We don't advocate killing anybody of any nation or proclivity. If you're a sodomite, we're not about harming you except with the word of God, and we hope it hurts.

That brother who left was a mouse, petite on the inside, no lion—or a lion with no teeth. Supple, quiet, like a silent and loving woman. They said he once had fire for the work, but he got seduced. Now he says he's been following dumb asses for ten years. Take out dumb; he was following that for twenty years, and I'm talking about men. He wasn't strong, loved the world, couldn't stay off those social media sites or whatever he was doing. Now he talks slick. Nigro, please. We know you. You're tender. I pray you repent and leave men's behinds alone. You got some balls, brother. What the hell is wrong with you?

“and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.” Stay fervent. Not only us, a nation that hasn't woken up yet is counting on you. Young ladies, love yourselves, your name and family. Respect yourselves. That stain is hard, impossible to shake off. For what? You're going to get dragged.

“And now, little children, abide in him”. “and not be ashamed before him at his coming.” Don't be ashamed you're an Israelite, to stand for the word, say you're a virgin, abstain from sex until marriage, or don't celebrate Christmas. To hell with Christmas. To hell with Halloween. Keep your nasty candy. I know peer pressure, but take on this mentality and stand different. We're getting old; you're the generation to keep this going. Don't be a part-time Israelite, sneak behind your parents' backs, or have conversations you shouldn't. Save yourself from this untoward generation.
“every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.” If you do righteousness, you're born of him.

precepts.why: “The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God”. That's the pride of the world. “and his heart is turned away from his Maker.” Your heart turns away and you want to revel. I've seen young ladies in IUIC with such a worldly look that you can't tell from their pages they're Israelites. It's not so much the drink in their hands; it's the fashion and the whole look. Some leadership turns a blind eye, acts like it doesn't see or care. If this is you, you love the world and still hang with worldly friends. It will be your demise. This isn't in the States; it wouldn't fly in Atlanta, Austin, or New York. You're not coming here with tongue rings. Take that stuff someplace else.

sense.text: “So God created man in his own image”. “male and female created he them.” The first thing young people out there need is identity. As wise master builders we need a plan, not just going to camp and passing flyers. Who are you reaching? Teach them who they are. God chose to make you after his likeness, what he looks like and the spirit of righteousness in him. Understand how special it is to be called his sons.

precepts.why: “And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.” That's the image. God created us to be righteous. Young men, God chose to make you after his likeness and gave you that spirit of righteousness. That's the message we must translate to the young ones.

“Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God”. What manner of love, that God made us in his image! Those other images of people in the world aren't made after his image. Those are recessive genes, a cursed hue. He chose us. That's why he says don't love the world; you're special, young men and young ladies, made after his expressed image. Why cheapen it or feel uncomfortable in who you are?

The world says you're nappy-headed and ugly and only want sex. The world hates you; the Bible says something totally different. We have to get that message to the youth in the streets. Captain Zephaniah sent clips of the young kids he was teaching. This identity opposes what the world tells them.

sense.text: “And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground”. “and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life”. Convey this to the young ones: you're made in his image, black and beautiful. The world told you otherwise. Young girls have been forced to cut their hair at school. They want to break and mar the image God created in you.

precepts.why: “they are black unto the ground”. God made you black unto the ground. He's telling you that you look like him—dark skin, dark and black like him.

“For wisdom is more moving than any motion”. “For she is the breath of the power of God”. Wisdom is that breath. “and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty”. The word of God is wisdom and a pure influence, supposed to influence you to do right. Why can you be seduced into something else? You might love the world; it has hold of you because the word isn't influencing you.

sense.text:
“With whose beauty if they being delighted took them to be gods”. They're worshipping other gods. “let them know how much better the Lord of them is: for the first author of beauty hath created them.” He created you after his image. Take this mindset to other young people. It's revolutionary, totally against society. Black people understanding this in the masses will cause a revolt in the world. Young people may receive it more easily from another young person than an old man with a Bible.

I tell my son he has more wisdom: finesse those teachers. When other kids act up, be nice. Good morning, how was your weekend? That D will turn to a B. My son told a child in front of the teacher, why are you giving him a hard time? He's a good guy. Now the teacher likes him, that little racist crap. Use it as a tool. Play with them, juggle them, toss them around. God gave you wisdom above these nations; tap into it.

“I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem”. Solomon is black and good-looking, black and handsome. Correlate blackness with being good-looking. God said it. To hell with what this world says. Believe and teach it. Sisters have trouble complimenting another sister, saying she looks cute. Why? Encourage each other. Brothers, don't go telling another brother he's cute or handsome like that.

He's saying it to the daughters of Jerusalem because our sisters battle with self-esteem. Be okay with your blackness; love it. Sisters, work on your self-esteem.

“to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.” Not only special—above all people. Media and schools make a concerted effort to strike that thought out of children's minds. Most young people don't know they're above, that God made them special. If you're made in his image and he's the author of beauty, he's telling you you're like him. God the Father, God the Son, God the man—that's us. We lost our place by sinning against God.

Churches don't teach children like this. They give Halloween candy, Christmas trees, Thanksgiving turkey, find out whether you can sing or whether your parents have tithes. They're not giving you the word that inspires and builds self-esteem. They're looking for salvation and eternal life, but failing miserably to galvanize the youth. Our mothers and grandmothers were in church and we got caught; young people recognize the hustle. The boys left there with their mamas are effeminate and weak, not like these young men.

Look at the young boys in green in that video. We have young men who can do that here and everywhere. They know these precepts. Keep their minds right and they'll turn this thing upside down. They buy into the system. We can give the churches the blueprint and they still can't do it, because God isn't inspiring them. They want to argue about the Trinity while these youths know the scriptures.

“shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee”. God prophesied we'd disconnect from our heritage, the laws of God. “and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not”. That fulfills the slave-ship prophecy in Deuteronomy 28. Before that, they knew Egypt, Babylon—Abraham came from Ur of the Chaldees—Haran, Asia Minor, Syria, the Assyrians. This was a land they didn't know, where they'd serve enemies and disconnect from their heritage.

You'd forget you're special and made in his image, forget you're supposed to be virgins from birth. That child called a bishop in the church says an ambassador loves God, but doesn't know what loving God means. He can't read Cat in the Hat; Hop on Pop gives him hell. How will he rightly divide anything? Our young ones can answer from the Bible.

precepts.why: “and the law of life for an heritage.” Being discontinued means disconnected from the law of life that gave us eternal life. Come back, apply the laws, let them run free course and change your life. Be the brothers and sisters who make the difference on earth. Nothing is wrong with being radical, against the system, as long as you aren't looking to pick up guns and hurt anybody.

sense.text: “For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments”. To hell with loving the world. This is what we cannot be seduced away from. “and his commandments are not grievous.” Young men, are you grieved about staying virgins or not being in gangs? You love God. Stand firm; don't let anyone move you or make you feel bad. Be bold and stiff in God's laws. Ladies, none of you want to be hoes. Stay firm and rooted.
“O Lord our Lord”. He isn't everybody's Lord. If he were, there'd be no reason to say our Lord. That's basic understanding. “how excellent is thy name in all the earth!”

“Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies”. Because of what the enemies do to God's people, his strength comes through the mouths of babes. Oppression and affliction will raise these youths to rebel against the system and keep the laws. The other nations, the Hamites and Moabites, are enemies. God's prophets are the avengers. These babes understand what pastors don't. That church stuff makes you dumb as hell.

“that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.” Still doesn't mean make both immovable. Look at the meanings: unmoving, then weaken. He'll weaken the enemies and make the avengers unmovable. Out of you young ones it will happen. You will change the earth. These boys know the Bible and are learning. Listen and be instructed.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”. Churches and urban apologists don't want you to know your enemy; they have that all-inclusive mentality. When do we fight for us? Hearing that whoever led us captive must go captive ought to ignite something, at least make you question it. Esau's movers and shakers have no problem understanding this. The inclusive ones in Birkenstocks and smoking patchouli aren't running anything. How many times must you or your people get clocked over the head before you see they don't like us? I'm not saying every one is like that, but the ones who aren't like that aren't fighting to change things. Don't feel bad about being Israelites or wearing fringes.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Look at a destroyed mind, or a mind used to destroy our people: that preacher says enslaved blacks didn't rally in Washington, good plantation people built churches and taught them to read the Bible, and 150 years ago they humbled themselves and prayed until white presidents ended slavery. I bet a black person agrees with him. You could drop dead. He's saying don't protest, stay weak, have no mind, be happy you were slaves.

Joshua, Jeremiah, Daniel—all the prophets were revolutionary, going against sin, immorality, and the nations. Daniel wouldn't bow to their gods. The American Revolution against Britain is celebrated with holidays because they wanted freedom from tyranny. What do you mean we didn't protest? Dred Scott went to the Supreme Court. What about Nat Turner and Denmark Vesey? We've always protested slavery. Christianity is foolish. That first-grade child pointing to the devil and calling him wicked—that's the mind our children should have.

The next men tell black people to grow up, stop whining about slavery, call living in America our reparations, and say otherwise we'd be in grass huts. They say the greatest moment for any brown or black country is when white ships arrive, bringing their gospel, hospitals, medicine, exports, longer life, GDP, and heaven. That makes you want to throw up. Devil, you stole Africa's resources to enrich Europe and America. Look at the land-grab map: Europe divided Africa and took its lands and resources. That continent made the world rich a thousand times over. We had civilizations while these dudes were in caves eating lice off their bodies in the Caucasus Mountains. That's their history, not something I'm making up. They stole America too. Church people leave their children stupid instead of equipping them with that truth. We aren't doing that.

precepts.why:
“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” That's what we do in the streets, teaching against what America taught us and warning of this place's destruction. Christians aren't on the corners saying it will end. They call that radical behavior now, but it's what the prophets always did.

America, the Crusades, coming here to enslave, murder, rape, and rob a country—that's radical behavior. When it's our turn to establish our kingdom, it's a problem. I'm not talking about raping or doing that. There's no revolution without bloodshed; we just have to wait on Christ. Lord, burn this thing up. Bring it down. If that's what it's called, sign me up.

sense.text:
“Never trust thine enemy”. Not sometimes or on Sunday—never. “for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” Polish him up and he'll revert to who he is. You might not find every Edomite or other nation like this, but all benefit from the oppression of God's children. Why would they stand against that system? Our liberation means their demise. I wouldn't do it if I were them. My responsibility is to ignite your minds so you don't see yourselves as less and stand against the system godly. Stay in scripture; no stupid stuff. Sisters are part of this mission too. They can't stop a godly nation. This mission is spiritual, changing our people's minds.

With natural chemistry, iron exposed to the right elements rusts. Evil is that characteristic: when you have something he wants, or don't obey how he thinks you should, the right exposure shows what he's made of.

The man in the clip tells him he didn't gain the world by saying we shall overcome, dealing fairly, or keeping his word: treaty breakers, liars, thieves, raping continents and races. Then they wonder why people don't trust them. Their religion means nothing, their law is a farce, demonstrated in Alabama. He profits from the system and makes his living from it, standing in his Sunday pulpit thanking Jesus. Their Jesus is contaminated like everything forced on us. That religion isn't for you. You're made in God's image, special to him and us. Don't feel bad about that. When we get older you must sit here and keep this work going until Christ returns. Death or imprisonment shouldn't stop it; when Christ returns the righteous rise again.

“Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him”. He makes concessions, acts nice, lets you sit in the front of the bus and drink from the fountain, then cracks your forehead when he's ready. “his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.” Wipe the glass; the rust isn't all gone. Meanwhile they rob your resources and say they want to bring you Jesus Christ. The devil. You'd have to be out of your mind.

“Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace”. We've been going through this too long; don't be silent anymore. “For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult”. The heathens are God's enemies. “and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” They lift their heads in pride.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people”. The land grab: how do we keep them enslaved and destroy their minds? Give them Lil Uzi Vert, Cardi B, Sexyy Red. That Sexyy Red makes Cardi B look like a daughter of Sarah. Don't love this world. Those chains mean nothing; they need to repent. “and consulted against thy hidden ones.” We are his hidden ones.

“let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” Separate us from our heritage so we forget who we are and believe we're Dominicans, Haitians, blacks, Puerto Ricans, Jamaicans, Mexicans. Split us up, grab the land, send some captive to East Asia, Saudi Arabia, the Americas and South America, rename us, give us white Jesus, filthy rap music and drugs, destroy the black man and raise up the black woman. These are plots and persuasions to destroy us.

They couldn't factor in God raising his prophets back on earth in the last days. It's a fixed game. Then we must combat Christianity from our own people. After the Deacon's eight-hour class, what's left to say? It was a snowball, a preponderance of evidence. If you still don't understand, put your head down and go back to sleep. Apologists don't know the Bible, but love the enemy.
“For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee”. All the nations work in one mind, in unison against God's people.

precepts.why:
“fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom”. Against Zobah, the Philistines, and the Amalekites too. God defines our enemies: Ammonites, Moabites, Chinese, Japanese, Esau, Africans. They conspire against us. Why can't Christians get that through their thick skulls? They don't want us to teach our children that they have enemies and must watch carefully.

A little child at school calls you 'Nigger.' Who taught him? His daddy and mama. Notice the jobs Esau takes: teachers, nurses, doctors, police and correction officers. You'll find Elam and the other nations in hospitals, and Edomite nurses. Police work doesn't pay that well and risks your life, but there's always a big thick Edomite doing it. Don't you find that suspicious?

My son had an Edomite teacher, Miss Yehudah. In first grade for Black History Month I made his report Christ is black: cotton hair, black skin, red eyes. She asked who it was. Jesus—look at Revelation. She was burnt, hated him, and tried to write him up every other day. She was a damn devil. Don't stand pledging allegiance to the place that enslaved you. What you instill in a child carries for life. He still remembers that report, and I still have it somewhere.

“wherefore was I born to see this misery of my people”. “when it was delivered into the hand of the enemy, and the sanctuary into the hand of strangers?” What do you mean we don't have enemies? It's throughout the Bible. The temple lost its glory, the glorious vessels went captive, infants were slain in the streets, young men by the enemy's sword. “What nation hath not had a part in her kingdom and gotten of her spoils?” Which nation hasn't benefited or destroyed us? They ran through Africa and robbed it. Wherever we go we're hated; go to China and see.

Look at that Moabite in Africa beating that Jake. Christianity pacified him. The man is hitting you in your country. It couldn't have been me; that video would've been different. I would've called everyone who didn't join me in beating him. You think you could go to China and do that? Where are the apologists up in arms about it? Look at the next clip, Amalek, the counterfeits, and that sister. These people hate your guts. Call me what you want, but you ain't the Jew, bro. You're the devil, and he's a punk. Know your enemies; don't fall for it.

sense.text:
“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord”. We can see the evidence: they hate the children of Israel. Separate from their mentality and everything they taught us in America, Babylon. When we separate they call us a hate group, radicalized, but the Bible commands it. “and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you”. Come out of Christmas, Thanksgiving, New Year's, their holidays and ways.

Officer Jordan in New York went to the same Brooklyn elementary school and found the picture of Miss Yehudah. That lady was a devil on earth. She saw my son's fringes and asked what they were, argued they should be tassels all the way around; he used to tuck them in, scared. She couldn't stand him. Look at these clips of people hurting our people. Where are the mother and father? Someone ought to crack him across the skull after he puts the child down. Don't tell me the father is recording; my pressure just went up.

Then there's the older man in the red Adidas shirt declaring the real Jews are black, he came out of church, tells his friends Israelite is the truth, and they hate him because they believe in white Jesus. More than likely a young brother teaching in the streets reached him. It's hard to engage older church people set in their ways, celebrating Christmas for 55 years and eating honey-baked ham. Most don't want change or persecution for Christ. Like the old generation in Egypt, they have to die off. I'm not saying none will make it, but most are set. That's why we want to influence the young ones.

“And I saw a new heaven and a new earth”. The new heaven and earth are the kingdom. “for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away”. How? Destruction. “and there was no more sea.” The sea is the other nations. These young brothers, thirteen and sixteen, can give the scriptures. You're anointed of God. Don't let love of the world seduce you out of that. You don't realize your power with this word. Grown people who spent their lives in church can't explain what is still elementary to you. These are the revolutionary, radical minds we're engaging.
“that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God”. That's the new heaven.
“the tabernacle of God is with men”. That's the order: with men.

“And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes”. That's what we're looking for, all affliction gone. “and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain”. Our communities know pain, police brutality and death, sorrow and crying at our enemies' hands. Engage the youth with the understanding that it won't always be that way.

“I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.” If we keep the commandments and endure to the kingdom, there'll be no more hunger, thirst, sorrow, tears, crying or pain. We understand these things in our community. Put in their minds that after all this it won't be the case anymore.

“He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.” Overcome the world, stand against it, stand stiffly for his name and do what he said. Then you're his son.

“shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.” You come back, get judged, and go to eternal damnation. The word to notice in that list is sorcerers. It connects to being seduced. Those sorcerers who seduce you and want you to sin will die right along with you if you fall for it. Officer Solomon connects the seducing to that sorcery.

precepts.why: “the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High”. That's the kingdom, the new heaven and new earth. “whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.”

“The Lord is not slack concerning his promise”. He is longsuffering, wanting repentance. “the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. “the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.” That's how the first heaven and earth pass away: nuclear destruction. The bombs drop, everything is done away, and he makes all things new.

“Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas”. “and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!” The seas are the nations, the other nations. That's precept upon precept explaining no more sea.

“These are they which came out of great tribulation”. That's us. “and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.” They serve before God's throne, and he dwells among them. “They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.” No affliction. “shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.” It's the same promise of no more tears or sorrow.

“He will swallow up death in victory”. The same thing as in First Corinthians. “and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces”. “and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth”. The Lord will remove this rebuke we're suffering. “for the Lord hath spoken it.” Young people need the end result in mind: we're going to come out on top. Endure.

sense.text:
“A man that hath travelled knoweth many things; and he that hath much experience will declare wisdom.” Listen first to your father and mother and experienced elder men and women in the truth. You haven't experienced enough to know how evil this world is. Satan plays at a level where even we can tap into things without realizing.

I can't stand my children leaving with a do-rag on. You're waiting for police to pull you over and crack your head. I pray God preserves them, but part of me wants them pulled over and cracked once—not killed—so I can say I told you. Officer Canai was reckless with that; Noah too. I'm glad Canai didn't get hit, but I wanted him to understand. I used to do it myself. At sixteen a policeman split my head with a nightstick, and I had one on. You think I'm joking or don't know? That happened to me.

I want my children to think, not be lobotomized. But sometimes just listen. There isn't time, or I can't express everything, but I'm trying to save and help you.

“He that hath no experience knoweth little”. You only know up to the life you've lived. A four-year-old knows ABCs and numbers, not paying bills or trigonometry. You haven't yet known marriage, children, being in love, working to pay bills for people depending on you. You'll get there.

Young men, stay godly, go to school, get a career or trade. Blink and sixteen becomes twenty-six. Buckle down and listen now, or you'll be saying welcome to Walmart, let me see that receipt, take that out your pocket, holding a little flashlight. You want a wife? Women should get educated too, but a rich man might marry a waitress; a successful woman isn't going to marry a waiter like that. Don't think your looks will carry you. Welcome to Chipotle—or you'll be in the back. Welcome to Buc-ee's. That's where you'll be.

“When I travelled, I saw many things; and I understand more than I can express.” I've lived so much it's hard to formulate every reason why something won't work. It's not some great wisdom; I've seen it so often I can tell how it'll go. Stop listening to yourself when you're about to malfunction. Don't listen, and Saturday morning I'm writing a class about you, like The Unadvisable Souls.

“I was ofttimes in danger of death: yet I was delivered because of these things.” Because of experience.

“The hopes of a man void of understanding are vain and false”. Without understanding and the fear of God, those hopes and desires won't come to pass. “and dreams lift up fools.” You really think you'll make a career playing PlayStation. “Whoso regardeth dreams is like him that catcheth at a shadow”. Those hopes and desires are like catching air, not real, but you're young and think you know.

“O how comely a thing is judgment for gray hairs, and for ancient men to know counsel!” “Much experience is the crown of old men, and the fear of God is their glory.” Get around men like that and learn. Approach the podium, ask questions, glean understanding. The same brother who likes men's behinds sat here over a year and never approached. I could see something wrong. When he faltered I gave him my number and offered to help. I didn't know about that part, but would've helped with scripture there too. He never used the opportunity to grow and fix himself, then flamed out. He's a punk.

On missions we're in the middle of the ocean, the ship only so big, yet brothers stay away. Do you know how much information comes out? Constantly avoiding that, staying on the fringes, won't make you a mover or shaker or radical in this truth. You're buying time. Young able-bodied men with good knees who don't go to camp or put their hand to anything—don't bring them around me; I don't want to catch what they have. You're useless. I need young men on fire, with so many questions I have to ask for a break. That's what keeps me going.

“Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.” Train young men in scripture so they retain it and can fight what's coming. Without desire to learn, you won't grow and you'll depart. Reach other young people: you're more relatable. They'll ask how you know these scriptures, what's the trick, who's telling you? They'll want to learn. You make this truth look cool.

Society and church have nothing for them, no social services or after-school centers. Get them off the streets and redirect that energy into God's word. Imagine them understanding they're a god on earth, these nations will go into captivity, and in the end they win.

“The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.” Train the child and he'll learn the laws, who borrows, who lends, and who his enemy is. The lender is in charge. The young brother remembers that a father raises an avenger; now identify that lender.

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.” The stranger rises above you and you fall low. “He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him”. “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”. Our enemies lend to us. In the hood: pawn shops, payday loans, SNAP, EBT. We're in financial ruins, seduced by rap videos and keeping up with the Joneses, buying all kinds of things without knowing God's laws. We're our worst enemies. Train the child to know the borrower, the lender, and his enemy.

Payday loans trap you in interest. Borrow $300 and pay $1,200 or $1,300; you'll be paying interest for the next thirty years. That's extortion, usury, oppression.
“Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.” That financial oppression makes a wise man mad.

“The Lord shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do”. God vexes everything we put our hands to, reminding us we sinned against him; in it we realize our enemy. You can't understand who you are without understanding who your enemy is. Parents and leaders do children a disservice by not equipping them. We're not telling you to harm anyone, but know who they are. How many times do they have to lynch your black behind before you understand they don't care? Churches fool people with slavery was good, you didn't protest, good white people took you—stop. Our young ones know the precepts and aren't fools behind that.

sense.text:
“Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise”. That's how they get you. “and stop up his mouth that he cannot reprove.” Church leaders receive subsidies, grants and money and are afraid to speak. Their mouths are stopped. At school, wicked holidays—Thanksgiving, Easter, Halloween, Christmas—come with candy and cupcakes. Don't eat food from people at school, especially your enemies. Wait until home and ask your parents. Stand firm in God's laws and obedience to your parents.

I saw that woman giving students cupcakes with her husband's semen in them. Look at the headline: teacher admits feeding students cupcakes laced with her husband's sperm. Who does that? What's wrong with these people? Filthy, base people. I'd break my children's behinds for eating that. I don't care what they offer; starve, eat nothing. Don't fall for the candy.
“Praise ye the Lord.” Thank God for all his creation, the angels, moon, sun and stars.

“Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children”. “Let them praise the name of the Lord”. Children must learn to praise God. Many learned Christmas from birth; these children must learn to thank and praise God from birth. That's how we build a nation of men and women who'll stand against the world. Instruct it into their minds in everything they do. We're awake and here because of God's mercy. Learn that while young.

“I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy”. Old men dream dreams; young men see visions. “And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.” “blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.” God will show young men and sisters the last days and the destruction coming. You'll understand and prophesy about it. Tell other young women to get right before destruction, because God will judge this earth.

It's not just brothers. Sisters, your life is the example; you're doing this because you understand destruction is coming and don't want part of it. God pours his spirit on you to speak these words. America's destruction means the rebirth of Israelite men and women ruling on earth. That's a radical mind, and that's a problem for this world.

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God”. We're in the last days. “and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy”. “blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke”. “The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood”. Same thing: sons, daughters and old men receive the spirit and see visions.

Young ladies, you can learn and read the Bible just as we can. You have the intelligence; you were made after man's image, made after God's image. Don't cheapen yourselves as though you can't understand. When you see the end and destruction, get prepared and prepare your little ones and other people. Tell them judgment is coming, repent, take off those pants, stop whoring—whatever brings them back to God.

“and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.” “upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.” That's the vision those sisters and men would see. The blood is death, death coming.

“And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit”. That's Europe. “and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.” Destruction is why the sun darkened. It connects to the blood, fire, smoke and darkened sun in Acts.

sense.text:
“For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required”. You younger generations understand much more Bible than I did, both at your age and at your time in the truth. You understand in two or three years what I didn't ten years in. The water has risen. That's how we know this is wrapping up. Where will the little ones answering Revelation take this? God isn't imparting it so you can sit on it.

Much is required. Be the radical ones unafraid to stand stiffly for the word. The babes in Psalms 8 become unmovable, taking on all doctrines without being confounded. They'll hate you for that, young men and young women. “and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.”
“waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward”. This vision is what we read in Revelation, the water of life.

“he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.” Through God's word. This is the progression of the truth and how it grew. When I came in, we shopped on the Sabbath, went from camp to the store, and women wore pants except on the Sabbath. The doctrine was rob them that robbed you. Prayers were curse the black woman, curse Oprah. There were multiple wives and dealing with heathen women. Then wisdom rose beyond the ankles and we learned we couldn't do that.

“the waters were to the knees.” Understanding changed: no Sabbath shopping, cursing our people in prayers, or robbing. Some stayed at the ankles. If wisdom is a pure influence, you'll change your mind and grow. “the waters were to the loins.” The Most High grew our understanding and our application of the law. Keeping the commandments is the key to growth. People ask our recipe: we stand on the commandments and faith of Jesus Christ. You can't have one without the other. Keep the commandments.

“it was a river that I could not pass over”. “waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.” The water rises until you can't get around it. That's happening now. We're everywhere, the word is everywhere. You can explain who you are from Deuteronomy 28, captivity and prophecy. You won't be tripped up by God so loved the world in John 3:16. Sisters can explain it too; that means God is dealing with you and you're anointed. Mark 7 isn't permission for pork; it's unwashed hands. First Timothy 4 doesn't mean you can eat everything. You can't get past this understanding.
“at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.” That's what we read in Revelation 22 about the tree and its leaves.
“because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary”. God's word, the laws. “and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.” That word is the medicine that cures you.

“go down into the desert, and go into the sea”. The word goes through America, Africa, Asia Minor, Europe, Saudi Arabia, down to Australia, all around the world. You can't get around us, block us out, or pretend we're not there. His sheep hear his voice. It takes radical minds to push this forward. We here in America have to set the world back in order under God's laws. The scepter won't depart from Judah or the lawgiver from between his feet. Judah is here.
“and there shall be a very great multitude of fish”. The word rises and the fishes learn because of you. You'll be the fishers of those men, sharing the water of this word throughout the earth.

precepts.why:
“But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.” It keeps growing. Imagine somebody in this room saying Christmas is okay or we can smoke weed. The whole room would react like a scratch on a chalkboard. Wisdom is prevalent. God has used others, but IUIC is in the vanguard pushing these laws, and that's fact, not feeling.

Other camps laughed years ago at our fringes, wearing them only on camp garments. Influence grew until their own people asked about Numbers saying garments, and they had to submit. I came from that generation and know those leaders; most city camps came out of the same school, doing the same things. But the waters rose. The Most High is moving young men and women to change things and stand stiffly in his laws without shame.

“on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits”. “and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.” Same trees and leaves as Ezekiel 47; the healing is in those words.
“a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, wherein is security and medicine”. Same medicine as the leaves. “them that are cured with his word”. God's word is the medicine that cures you.
“And makest men as the fishes of the sea”. Men are the fishes. As the word rises, those men learn through you; share this word, this water, throughout the whole earth.

sense.text: “And he shewed me a pure river of water of life”. That pure river is wisdom, God's word. “clear as crystal”. His laws and wisdom will be clear to the righteous.
“which bare twelve manner of fruits”. Those fruits are the twelve disciples. “and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.” The words heal.

precepts.why: “For she is the breath of the power of God, and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty”. “therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.” “For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of God, and the image of his goodness.” That pure river running there is wisdom.
“My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.” Knowledge clearly—that's clear as crystal. God's words, laws and wisdom will be clear to the righteous.

sense.text:
“shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end”. The word was shut until the end. “many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.” Now the Most High has opened it, and we can understand and explain it. He's anointed leadership, brothers, sisters and you young ones. You explain things beyond most adults. You know more Bible than 99 percent in the churches. The other one percent may know but be the devil and refuse to change. You will confound them.

A pastor I know graduated Princeton Seminary and leads a big church in Philadelphia. Years ago he told me of a problem with a brother we both knew. I asked whether he used Matthew 18. Matthew 18? He didn't know it. A degree on his wall, and he didn't know something so elementary as how to deal with his brother. This is who's going to lead you to Jesus? Man, please.

“Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth”. “and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes”. Are you supposed to walk your own heart's way? If that's what you want, walk however you want. “but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.” Young men think they're invincible with all their lives ahead. Live it up if you want; God will judge you. Decide whether to stay in sin, be seduced, love the world and evil rap music.

If you're different here than somewhere else, you're the devil, doing wrong. You should talk the same around anyone without being unnerved. A secret life means you're a sinner with the devil on you.

“Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh”. “for childhood and youth are vanity.” Youth is fleeting, short like a vapor. If God spares you, one day you'll wake up with gray hair. Gather wisdom and righteous memories now, so you can tell the Father you fought a good fight, kept the faith and taught his people. Or do it your way and say good morning, welcome to Walmart.

“Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible”. “and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.” Don't be afraid. Fight for your people. Be that radical young man or woman; step up. Make little five-minute videos. Those three young-prophet videos sent to Officer Ryder are impressive. You're charged to fight for what's right, stand against the world, and hold up and establish God's laws.

“Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king’s house, more than all the Jews.” Esther was in position to approach the king and save her people. Don't think holding back shields you in the king's house.

“For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time”. If you hold back from what God charged you to do, “then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place”. He doesn't need me or you; he'll find someone else. Deliverance is coming, but don't be the one cast aside. We answer for what we do in this body. Those hiding and afraid know they're in sin and judgment is coming. They won't put everything on the line. They trim their ways and sell us out.

“but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed”. “and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?” God woke each of us at a particular time for a purpose. Young ones, you're not here by chance. You're designed to be here today and hear this, to have something ignited in you.

“Do not prostitute thy daughter”. “lest the land fall to whoredom”. Look at the HBCU homecomings. Are those women dressed and covered? No. That's what's happening at those colleges. Look how impactful it is to hear a young man his own peers' age bring this out. It ripples through the earth. Esau is angry with that. These avengers are back to stand against the enemy, who wants our women to stay that way.

Young people will receive someone who looks like them more readily than somebody old like me, somebody's grandfather. Sisters will stop to watch a young brother pulling precepts sooner than watch me talk Bible. Young men, understand the effect you have.

“If thou hast gathered nothing in thy youth”. Gather it now. The youth will be next. They're looking forward to MOV and being young prophets. They see us marching; at fifteen they're watching, and at twenty or twenty-one they'll march in the line. That young brother bringing points in the video gathered them in his youth. It connects to the young men's strength in First John 2:14 and training children in Proverbs 22:6.

“which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children”. “That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born”. It's imperative to teach the children the laws, enemies, and prophecies so they're equipped. Fathers teach children who teach the next generation. That's radicalization, and it's succession planning.

Put a system in place so wherever we are, young men and women stand fervent for the Lord. Nothing is greater for leadership than knowing that if Christ hasn't returned and we die or spend life in prison, business continues and you carry Christ's banner until he returns. Otherwise everything we're doing is for nothing. You're the generation to make this happen. That's why you were brought to the front: understand its severity and what it means for your lives.
“That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments”. Don't forget. Remember God's works and keep his commandments.

“Be as a father unto the fatherless, and instead of an husband unto their mother”. Older men, some young men have no father in this truth. Be their father, their mentor, give direction and spark this in them. You're not trying to bag the mom. Make sure the next generation has these scriptures. Without a father these young men will be led astray. Keep guiding and molding them until they reach that age. Young people, I'm proud of you. Stay faithful, stay godly, and let's take this kingdom.
